items.title: Intelligent Energy Apps with Firebase AI Logic
items.summary: How do developers transform overwhelming, raw home energy telemetry into calm, intuitive, and highly actionable user experiences? This talk outlines how to build intelligent, AI-driven utility co-pilots by leveraging the intersection of native mobile development, IoT, and generative AI.Using a reference iOS application called "WattsUp," this presentation explores a progressive architectural roadmap for developers. The session demonstrates how to integrate Google’s Gemini models into Swift and SwiftUI applications using Apple’s native FoundationModels and Firebase AI Logic.
